faqs.bookQuestion: How do I book a worker?
faqs.bookAnswer: Browse services or search for a worker, choose the provider that fits your needs, then select a date and time and confirm your booking details.
faqs.cancelQuestion: How can I cancel a booking?
faqs.cancelAnswer: Open My Bookings, select the booking you no longer need, and follow the available cancellation option. Cancellation availability can depend on the booking status.
faqs.paymentAnswer: After a worker accepts your request, you will be guided to complete payment securely through the payment step shown in your booking.
faqs.contactQuestion: How do I contact a worker?
faqs.contactAnswer: Once you have a booking or conversation with a provider, use Chat to send them a message directly.
faqs.absentQuestion: What happens if a worker does not arrive?
faqs.absentAnswer: Check your booking status and message the worker first. If you still need help, send us the booking details through the support form below.
faqs.reportQuestion: How can I report a problem?
faqs.reportAnswer: Use the Contact Support form with a clear description of the issue. Include your booking reference, if you have one, so the team can understand the situation.

aboutPage.title: Building better local service connections
aboutPage.description: ActiveSetu connects customers with verified local gig and service workers for dependable everyday services, while creating stronger visibility and opportunity for skilled people in local communities.

purpose.title: Making local services easier to trust and access
purpose.text1: Finding a trusted local service worker can still be difficult. Information is often fragmented, skills are not always visible, and customers may not know where to begin.
purpose.text2: At the same time, skilled local workers need better visibility, more consistent opportunities, and a platform that recognizes the value of their work. ActiveSetu brings these needs together through a more connected local service ecosystem.

vision.title: To build a trusted, inclusive and technology-driven ecosystem for India's local service workforce.
vision.description: We see a future where local work is easier to discover, professional skills are more visible, and customers and workers can build better service relationships.

commitment.title: Creating value on both sides of every service connection
commitment.text1: For customers, ActiveSetu is committed to making local service discovery more dependable, clear, and convenient. For workers, we are committed to improving visibility for verified skills, supporting access to local opportunity, and keeping worker wellbeing central to the platform's growth.
commitment.text2: Every service connection is an opportunity to strengthen local trust, work, and community.
